summary: The default easy generator admits a shortest-option shortcut: 40/40 fresh questions and all 5 delivered batch questions are answered correctly without reading the prompt. It also excludes source capacity-discrimination banks. Package files remain unchanged; no publishing or database writes occurred. Full report: result.json.

source_analysis.skill: Translate inhibited-growth prose into dX/dt=k(a-X), distinguishing equilibrium from initial population, and select one equation.
reasoning_steps: Identify the dependent variable and equilibrium capacity.
Distinguish capacity from any initial population.
Express positive growth proportional to the remaining gap.
Select the matching whole-equation radio choice.
invariants: Positive proportionality constant and growth from below equilibrium.
Five radio alternatives with one correct equation.
No integration, parameter fitting, or explicit solution required.
permitted_variations: Context, units, variable, capacity, and below-capacity initial population.
Correct option position and plausible distractor capacities.
Which candidate capacity matches the equilibrium stated in the prompt.
source_refs: Tutorial 9afedae3-a674-5a44-9d7a-4cdf57e66285: rate depends on distance from equilibrium; dP/dt=r(a-P), r>0, P<a.

source_replay.details: All 14 captured question banks reproduce their 70 choices, prompts, solutions, keys, difficulties, or captured absences. Canonical answer bank is unavailable; rehabilitation key/solution are missing. Factory units inconsistency is documented.

math.details: Independent exact checks found one correct equation per tested bank across fresh samples, runner batch, controlled pairs, source banks, and capacity boundaries.

variety.details: Default easy generation uses only the structural bank. Source banks requiring discrimination among candidate capacities are excluded from normal learning.

scope.details: Requested easy outputs preserve first-order model selection, unknown positive k, and the source response workload.

grading.details: Native grader accepted 27 correct selections and rejected 108 wrong selections. Reviewer counterfactual fixtures added 2 accepted and 8 rejected checks. Free-entry notation is inapplicable to these radio fields.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendered the batch and controlled pairs correctly. Inspected screenshots show legible mathematics, radio controls, and complete solutions.

packaging.details: Exact runtime versions match the manifest. Determinism, relocation, boundary generation/rejection, and runtime dependencies were checked. Package hashes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Shortest-option selection succeeds on all 40 fresh and 5 delivered questions, including every sampled context subgroup. Filtering and selection among surviving easy records preserve the cue. Ten stored generated records were reproduced; all are moderate/hard, so none belongs to this demonstrated easy defect.

findings.description: The correct default easy equation is always uniquely shortest. Every distractor adds a minus sign, population factor, or power. Choosing by length bypasses modeling and answers the entire delivered batch.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run: /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B reproduce_shortcut.py --input boundary-records.json --index 0 --output shortcut-minimal.json. Expected exit 1. Minimal instance: generate_easy(seed=88, parameters={'context':'deer','capacity':20}). check_shortcuts.py reproduces 40/40 fresh and 5/5 delivered successes.
findings.requested_change: Revise easy bank construction so equation length cannot identify correctness within recognizable templates. Include plausible same-method alternatives requiring the stated equilibrium. Regenerate the batch and retain the strict shortcut regression.

findings.description: Normal easy sampling excludes source banks whose alternatives differ by capacity. Historical distractor ratios additionally reject valid equilibrium reassignment: tutoring capacity 60 and initial 10 fails despite requiring the same source reasoning.
findings.reproduction: Run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B fixed_bank_probe.py. generate_easy(seed=624, template='source_17592186308739', parameters={'capacity':60,'initial':10}) raises 'whole observed bank needs bounded integer constants'. fixed-bank-records.json demonstrates the valid unchanged-bank capacity95→60 reference pair; actual grading and rendering confirm the changed correct choice.
findings.requested_change: Include competing-capacity banks in normal easy sampling. Generate distinct plausible distractor capacities from instructional constraints rather than exact historical ratios, and derive correctness from the stated equilibrium. Preserve exact source replay separately.
